study type: Pilot experimental study with longitudinal measurements
cohort: Six s-trimester pregnant women with high hepatitis B viral load (HBVL) and no intrauterine infection.
finding: The expression profile of serum lncRNAs in pregnant women with high HBVL changed significantly from the second trimester until delivery under antiviral or non-antiviral treatment, with identified co-differentially expressed lncRNAs potentially serving as markers for evaluating the necessity of antiviral treatment.
